start: A member on an Android phone with Health Connect installed, not yet connected, with finished workouts

steps.action: Open Settings, Phone and watch, 'Health apps'
user_sees: Page 'Health apps'; row 'Health Connect' with 'Send each finished workout and its calories to Google Health and Samsung Health, through Health Connect.' and a 'Connect' button
must_not: A send before the member taps anything

steps.action: Tap 'Connect' and allow 'Exercise' on Health Connect's screen, come back
user_sees: Caption 'On. Each workout you finish goes to Health Connect as strength training...'; a 'Stop' link
must_not: The row still Off after access was given

steps.action: Tap 'Send past workouts'
user_sees: A question that says how many workouts, from when to when and where they go, with 'Not now'
must_not: Workouts sent without a yes (R-72)

steps.action: Say yes
user_sees: Progress while sending, then how many went
must_not: The same workout sent twice; a success line when Health Connect refused

start: A member with a Wear OS watch paired, MettleUp not on the watch

steps.action: Open Settings, Phone and watch, 'Your watch'
user_sees: Row 'MettleUp works on your watch too' with 'Install on watch'; switch 'Open MettleUp on my watch'
must_not: The install row on a phone with no watch

steps.action: Tap the row
user_sees: 'Check your watch: its Play Store is open on MettleUp. Tap Install there.'
must_not: Two Play Store opens from a double tap

steps.action: Tap the row once the watch app is installed
user_sees: 'MettleUp is already on your watch. When you start a workout, it opens on your watch too.'
must_not: The row still saying 'Install on watch'

start: A member in a gym, on an Android launcher that takes widgets

steps.action: Open Settings, Phone and watch, 'Widgets'
user_sees: Row 'Home-screen widgets', 'Your next workout and your week, on your home screen.'; buttons 'Add Next workout', 'Add This week', 'Add Gym right now'
must_not: 'Add Gym right now' for a member with no gym

steps.action: Tap 'Add This week', accept the home screen's question, come back
user_sees: Caption '1 on your home screen. Add another, or long-press your home screen -> Widgets -> MettleUp.'
must_not: A count that says placed when the home screen showed nothing

start: A member whose phone has no Health Connect, an old one, or who refuses access

steps.action: Open Health apps on a phone without Health Connect
user_sees: 'Health Connect is not available on this phone.' (or 'Install or update Health Connect from the Play Store first.' with 'Open Health Connect')
must_not: A Connect button that cannot work

steps.action: Tap 'Connect', refuse twice
user_sees: 'Nothing opened? Open Health Connect, find MettleUp and allow it there.' and 'Open Health Connect'
must_not: Caption 'On' while nothing is allowed

steps.action: Tap 'Open Health Connect' when it cannot open
user_sees: 'Couldn't open Health Connect. Open your phone's Settings -> Health Connect.'
must_not: Nothing happening with no word

start: A member with no watch connected, or a launcher that refuses widgets

steps.action: Open Your watch with no watch
user_sees: No install row; only 'Open MettleUp on my watch'
must_not: An install row that opens nothing

steps.action: Tap 'Add Next workout' on a launcher that refuses pinning
user_sees: A hint line under the buttons saying it could not be added
must_not: A widget count that goes up with nothing placed

start: A member with Health Connect on

steps.action: Tap 'Stop'
user_sees: 'Stopped. New workouts will not go to Health Connect. Workouts already sent stay there. To remove them, open Health Connect.' and 'Turn on'
must_not: A workout finished after Stop still sent

steps.action: Tap 'Turn on'
user_sees: Caption back to 'On. ...'
must_not: Workouts finished while stopped sent without asking

steps.action: Use 'Stop and remove MettleUp's access', say yes
user_sees: 'Removed. MettleUp can no longer use Health Connect...' and the row shows Off
must_not: The row still showing On after access is removed

start: A member with Health Connect on and weight or steps read switched on

steps.action: Finish a workout; open the Gym tab and the panel side
user_sees: The workout goes to Health Connect only
must_not: Weigh-ins, steps or sleep from Health Connect sent to the gym or to any AI
